Deploy Bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for canary rollout 2024-06-12T09:02Z. Model variant model-v3-quant is reporting elevated 5xx and P99 latency. Smart-routing has attempted fallback -> region-us-west, but we are seeing repeated affinity/fallback oscillation. Paging @oncall.
Grace P: picking this up. I'm on my laptop, grabbing logs and routing state.
Rajat S: seeing the same. Traffic initially spiked errors at 09:00 UTC after the canary flip. Router logs show clients with sticky-affinity still set to variant id "v3-quant" and fallback policy returns them to region-us-west which then routes back to a warmed but failing v3 instance. Looks like a sticky+fallback interaction creating a loop.
Elena M: quick snippet from router trace (redacted):

```
[09:01:12] route req id=abc123 -> variant=v3-quant region=us-east sticky=true
[09:01:12] variant v3-quant responds 500 (KV cache OOM)
[09:01:12] fallback -> region=us-west variant=v3-quant
[09:01:13] region us-west returns 502
[09:01:13] router reapplies sticky affinity -> client still tied to v3-quant
```
Rajat S: also seeing repeated TTL refreshes for the sticky keys. The fallback policy is compatible with v3-quant, so router thinks fallback is valid and reassigns — but the variant itself is unhealthy across regions.
ops-bot: Auto-action: canary rollout paused (console id: rollout-775). Notified deployment owners. :white_check_mark:
Grace P: I'm going to force traffic to stable variant v2-stable and evict sticky keys for affected route (/api/generate). Commands I'm running:

```
redwoodctl rollout pause --id rollout-775
redwoodctl routing set-affinity --route "/api/generate" --evict-sticky forever
redwoodctl traffic shift --route "/api/generate" --variant v2-stable --weight 100
```
Rajat S: running evict now. Watch for increased 200s on stable. If the stable variant sees sudden load we might need to warm an extra replica.
Grace P: evict command returned OK. Forcing traffic shift to v2-stable now.
Elena M: after shift we see 85% 200s, some 504s during the handover window but dropping. P99 latency trending down.
Maya (CS Lead): Noting customer impact — early telemetry shows ~3% of customer requests got retries/5xx during the 3 minute window, a handful of premium customers reported timeouts. Opening a CS incident and sending an advisory to affected accounts.
oncall-rotation: action items: (1) keep rollout paused, (2) run deeper health check on v3-quant image, (3) collect perf traces and model logs, (4) coordinate rollback if repro is quick.
Rajat S: initial hypothesis: quantized kernels in v3-quant aren't handling long-context KV memory patterns; memory growth -> OOMs -> 5xx. We'll repro in staging with long-seq synthetic tests.
Grace P: I'm triggering an emergency rollback plan but won't delete any artifacts until we confirm root cause. Rolling back to v2-stable for production; canary remains paused.
Elena M: uploading relevant logs to the incident folder -> https://redwood.internal/incident/1719012345/logs (link)
ops-bot: Eviction confirmed. Router state shows sticky entries cleared for 2,432 clients on /api/generate. Traffic now 100% -> v2-stable.
Deploy Bot: :white_check_mark: Canary rollback executed. Monitoring ongoing. Auto-alerting will remain active for 30m.
Grace P: timeline: 09:00 canary flip -> 09:01 errors spike -> 09:03 auto-pause -> 09:04 manual evict/shift -> 09:07 stable restoration. Postmortem owner: @Rajat S. I'll draft the immediate summary for execs.
Maya (CS Lead): I'll coordinate customer communications and share the list of impacted customers. Suggested message: brief root cause + apology + compensation offer if SLA threshold crossed. :thumbsup:
Rajat S: next steps: reproduce in staging w/ long-context synthetic load, add a preflight for kernel compatibility, and add a routing policy change to prefer variant-health over sticky when fallback occurs more than 2x in 1m.
Grace P: Agreed. Also adding a short-term mitigation: when fallback triggers twice within 30s for the same client, force-eject sticky for that client to avoid oscillation.
Elena M: will attach a heaptrace and kernel logs in the postmortem. Early indicator: memory spike correlating with sequence length > 4096.
Maya (CS Lead): CS action: reaching out to affected accounts now, offering incident summary and ETA for fix.
Grace P: closing the page here. Reopen if errors reappear > 0.5% for next 15m. Thank you all. :heart:
